light.line: A Marshfield nonprofit called Shine Through Faith, founded by Heather Rodriguez, started by helping older neighbors stay in their homes and now helps families, foster kids and teachers too.
Three Waynesville lodges and chapters donated 50 headphones for elementary students and clothing for the school nurses' offices on Oct. 20.
Waynesville bus drivers and aides celebrated School Bus Safety Week by handing out stickers and pencils to kids, and on Oct. 21 the drivers got treated to pizza.
Rockin' Rogersville started as one night of live music and has grown into a full community festival that raises money to give back to Rogersville.
A Lake of the Ozarks nonprofit is helping women start over by offering them housing, support and hope.
